Broadcom Inc. is a public company headquartered in Palo Alto, California, trading under the ticker AVGO. Its SEC Central Index Key is 0001730168. The company describes itself as delivering semiconductors and infrastructure software for global enterprises' most complex, mission-critical needs.

The available facts include 281 legal exposure records in California. No specific product names or MCP servers are listed in the data.
